name: AxCNH
oneLiner: AxCNH is AnchorX's centralized offshore-yuan stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 for CNH and backed by CNH cash reserves at regulated financial institutions.
collateral: Offshore Chinese yuan (CNH) cash reserves held 1:1 at regulated financial institutions; issuer materials describe AxCNH as fully reserved and redeemable for CNH
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 issuance and redemption through AnchorX for CNH transfers; the issuer publishes reported circulating AxCNH and corresponding CNH reserves on its transparency page

mintAuthority.summary: AxCNH is issued by AnchorX Ltd (Kazakhstan, AFSA-licensed); minting and 1:1 CNH redemption run through the issuer's centralized backend against offshore-yuan cash reserves. Ethereum and Conflux mint surfaces confirmed: both chains use a MultiSigWallet (4 EOA signers, threshold 3) as masterMinter, and an EOA or multisig as token owner.

controls.label: AnchorX Ltd issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: AnchorX creates AxCNH supply against custodied CNH reserves and redeems 1:1 for CNH transfers; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route is described.

controls.label: AxCNH Ethereum masterMinter multisig
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295029, masterMinter() on AxCNH (0x2925...8239) returned 0x5246b59a9e9473e680ea52ecda4a8dcff3fbfc97. Blockscout identifies it as a MultiSigWallet contract. getOwners() returned 4 EOAs: 0xccef4766..., 0xfe0ef595..., 0xca7554f8..., 0x213c69ca... All 4 confirmed as EOAs via eth_getCode. required() returned 3.

controls.label: AxCNH Ethereum token owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295029, owner() on AxCNH returned 0xf9f304225756edfe9a05d7ea235b0b181380edd5. eth_getCode returns no bytecode → EOA.

controls.label: AxCNH Conflux masterMinter multisig
controls.evidence: On Conflux EVM, masterMinter() on AxCNH (0x70bfd7...ae2e) returned 0x8b26530b369f7eb499597bbde00ed8a4a77d74d0. Same MultiSigWallet pattern (9054 bytes). getOwners() returned 4 EOAs: 0x311c5f43..., 0x53f2ec2f..., 0x68b0bbce..., 0x134586b2...; all confirmed as EOAs. required() = 3.

controls.label: AxCNH Conflux token owner multisig
controls.evidence: On Conflux EVM, owner() on AxCNH returned 0xf80b9c06a601351612b3324d8cd0f57cf7952e1b. Same 9054-byte MultiSigWallet. getOwners() returned 4 addresses: 0xb987a2df..., 0x81c4d977..., 0xbba02240..., 0x3d01edf6...; required() = 3.

review.evidence: AnchorX materials describe a single AFSA-regulated issuer minting AxCNH against off-chain CNH reserves. Both Ethereum and Conflux chains confirmed: masterMinter is a 3-of-4 MultiSigWallet contract on each chain; token owner is EOA (Ethereum) and 3-of-4 multisig (Conflux). All multisig signers verified as EOAs. Confirmed at Ethereum block 25295029 and Conflux EVM RPC.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: AxCNH is reviewed as an issuer-native multichain token: supply is issued or redeemed by the issuer/operator on supported chains rather than through a separately identified third-party bridge token. Missing evidence for a public bridge lockbox keeps confidence below verified.
